title: It Shouldn't Be Here
text:
The cuts appear more frequently, closer together, like whoever made them was panicking. Then they stop.

Ahead of you, the path ends at a small wooden cabin. No smoke. No sound. Just a structure sitting too still, belonging to the forest but foreign to it. The door is slightly open. You tell yourself not to go inside.

choices.label: Step forward and push the door wide open
Peer through the crack before entering
